elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims covered by the specified indemnity triggers.
elements.evidence: Section b requires TrueLink to indemnify and hold Client and its affiliates harmless from all claims, which is broad enough to encompass third-party claims.

elements.element: Vendor defends Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims covered by the specified indemnity triggers.
elements.evidence: Section b contains indemnify and hold-harmless duties and covers attorneys’ fees, but it does not expressly require TrueLink to defend claims.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers third-party claims alleging that the services or deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Section b(ii) covers allegations that the Interface, Hosting Services, Support Services, or other TrueLink materials or deliverables infringe or misappropriate patents, copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets, or other IP rights.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers third-party claims arising from Vendor's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Section b(iii) expressly covers TrueLink's breach of any applicable law, rule, or regulation.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers third-party claims arising from a data breach caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Section b(iv) covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or other Client data caused by TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor indemnity covers third-party claims arising from Vendor's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Section b(v) expressly covers TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires Customer to provide notice of a covered claim.
elements.evidence: No notice requirement or notice procedure appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure gives Vendor control of the defense of a covered claim.
elements.evidence: No defense-control provision appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires Customer to provide reasonable cooperation in the defense of a covered claim.
elements.evidence: No cooperation obligation appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: Customer indemnity covers claims arising from Customer-provided content.
elements.evidence: Section a(iii) covers claims arising from Client Content, including content posted by Client or its personnel.

elements.element: Customer indemnity covers claims arising from Customer's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Section a(ii) includes violations of state or federal laws, rules, or regulations resulting from acts or omissions by Client or its authorized customers.

elements.element: Customer indemnity has no triggers other than Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Section a additionally covers any Client breach of the Agreement, conduct causing TrueLink to breach System or Credit Repository Agreements, claims relating generally to the Web Site, and injury or property damage caused by products, services, or information distributed through the Web Site.

elements.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party claims alleging that the services or deliverables infringe or misappropriate intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Section b(ii) provides an IP indemnity covering the Interface, Hosting Services, Support Services, and other TrueLink materials or deliverables.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity excludes claims caused by Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No exclusion for Customer modifications appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity excludes claims caused by combinations with items not supplied or approved by Vendor.
elements.evidence: No combination exclusion appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity excludes claims resulting from Customer-provided specifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-specification exclusion appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: For covered infringement, Vendor must procure the right for Customer to continue using the affected services or deliverables.
elements.evidence: No procure-right remedy appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: For covered infringement, Vendor must modify the affected services or deliverables to make them non-infringing.
elements.evidence: No modification remedy appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: For covered infringement, Vendor must replace the affected services or deliverables with non-infringing substitutes.
elements.evidence: No replacement remedy appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: If the other infringement remedies are unavailable, Vendor must refund the applicable fees.
elements.evidence: No refund remedy appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: Vendor's indemnification liability is subject to a super-cap equal to three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no liability cap or three-times-annual-fees super-cap.

result.reason: The redline adds all specified Vendor indemnity triggers, but it omits an express defense duty and all notice, control, and cooperation procedures, while leaving Client's indemnity materially broader than permitted. It also omits every fallback exclusion, infringement remedy, and the 3× annual-fees super-cap. Unrelated operative terms are generally preserved and no direct contradiction is introduced, but neither complete position is achieved.
